name: Timeline for a Seamless Home Addition Project

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation & Concept Development (2-4 weeks)
step.text: This is where your vision takes shape! You’ll meet with a general contractor like Affordable Home Remodeling to discuss your needs, budget, and ideas. We'll look at your existing home, potential expansion areas, and discuss preliminary designs. This phase is all about understanding what you want and assessing feasibility. You'll get a rough estimate and a clearer picture of what's possible.

step.name: Step 2: Design & Architectural Planning (4-12 weeks)
step.text: Once the concept is solid, architects and designers will create detailed blueprints. This involves structural drawings, floor plans, and material selections. You’ll have opportunities for feedback and revisions to ensure everything aligns with your dream. This stage is crucial for getting all the details right before any construction begins, preventing costly changes later on.

step.name: Step 3: Permitting & Approvals (4-16 weeks)
step.text: This step can sometimes be the longest, depending on your city and the complexity of your project. Your contractor will submit the architectural plans to local building departments (e.g., in Irvine, Yorba Linda, or Glendale) for review and approval. They'll ensure compliance with California building codes and local zoning requirements, which can be quite specific for different areas. Patience is key here, but it’s a non-negotiable step to ensure your addition is safe and legal.

step.name: Step 4: Construction & Framing (8-20 weeks)
step.text: With permits in hand, construction kicks off! This phase involves site preparation, foundation work, framing the new structure, roofing, and installing windows and doors. The goal is to get the addition 'dried in' – meaning it's protected from the elements. Regular site visits and communication with your project manager are essential during this active building period.

step.name: Step 5: Interior & Exterior Finishes (6-16 weeks)
step.text: Now for the exciting part – seeing your vision come to life! This includes electrical and plumbing rough-ins, insulation, drywall, painting, flooring, and installing all the fixtures, cabinets, and appliances. On the exterior, siding, stucco repair, and final landscaping touches are completed. Quality control is paramount here to ensure every detail meets your expectations and our high standards for craftsmanship.

step.name: Step 6: Final Walkthrough & Project Completion (1-2 weeks)
step.text: Before final payment, you’ll do a thorough walkthrough with your contractor to identify any last-minute adjustments or touch-ups. Once you’re completely satisfied, the project is officially wrapped up. Affordable Home Remodeling provides warranties on labor and stands behind our work, ensuring your peace of mind long after we've finished. Welcome to your beautiful new space! This timeline gives you a good idea of the journey, but remember, things can shift. We're here to keep you informed every step of the way.
